title: Summerween Announcement
scene: BookTube 頻道主 Gabby 公布第七屆 Summerween 夏日驚悚讀書馬拉松的日期、五個閱讀題目與周邊商品，也聊接下來幾個月想讀的書。

video.title: SUMMERWEEN readathon announcement! 👻🌞 (May TBR, announcing Book Troop book club picks!)

lines.en: Hey, how's it going?
lines.zh: 嘿，你好嗎？

lines.en: Welcome back to my channel.
lines.zh: 歡迎回到我的頻道。

lines.en: My name is Gabby, and today we have a very exciting video because in this video, I'm not only going to be talking
lines.zh: 我是 Gabby，今天的影片非常令人興奮，因為在這支影片裡，我不只要聊

lines.en: about some of my TBR plans for the upcoming months, but it's also going to include the Summerween readathon announcement.
lines.zh: 我接下來幾個月的待讀書單計畫，也會公布 Summerween 讀書馬拉松的消息。

lines.en: If you're new to my channel, you might not know, but I host this readathon called Summerween every single July.
lines.zh: 如果你是新來的，可能不知道，我每年七月都會主辦一個叫 Summerween 的讀書馬拉松。

lines.en: This is an annual spooky readathon that I love to host because the main goal of this readathon is to bring the spooky
lines.zh: 這是一年一度的驚悚讀書活動，我很愛主辦，因為這個活動的主要目標，是把萬聖節的驚悚

lines.en: vibes of Halloween into the summer, and this is going to be the seventh round of Summerween.
lines.zh: 氛圍帶進夏天，而今年是第七屆 Summerween。

lines.en: Can you believe that we've been here this long doing this together?
lines.zh: 你能相信我們已經一起做了這麼久嗎？

lines.en: I just love Summerween so much.
lines.zh: 我真的太愛 Summerween 了。

lines.en: Like this readathon is truly my pride and joy on this channel.
lines.zh: 這個讀書活動真的是我在這個頻道上的驕傲和喜悅。

lines.en: And so, let's talk about all of the details because I'm very excited to let you know everything.
lines.zh: 所以，來聊聊所有細節吧，因為我超興奮要讓你們知道一切。

lines.en: So, the official dates for this readathon, this readathon's going to be happening in the month of July as it always does.
lines.zh: 官方日期方面，這次活動一如往常，會在七月舉行。

lines.en: We're going to be kicking things off on Friday, July 3rd, and this readathon is going to be going for a week
lines.zh: 我們會在 7 月 3 日星期五開跑，活動會進行一個星期，

lines.en: until July 9th.
lines.zh: 到 7 月 9 日。

lines.en: So, the official dates are going to be Friday, July 3rd through the 9th.
lines.zh: 所以官方日期是 7 月 3 日星期五到 9 日。

lines.en: And if you were wondering, we do kind of have a theme again for this year's Summerween, you know, because if you recall
lines.zh: 如果你在好奇，今年的 Summerween 一樣有個主題，因為如果你還記得，

lines.en: last year, we did kind of like the space desert, you know, almost like sci-fi UFO kind of a vibe.
lines.zh: 去年我們做的是太空沙漠風，有點像科幻、幽浮的感覺。

lines.en: And this year, we're mixing it up once again because this time, the theme is going to be kind of like a summer
lines.zh: 今年我們又要換個花樣，因為這次的主題是類似夏日

lines.en: fair carnival type of vibe as you might have noticed on the shirt that I'm wearing.
lines.zh: 園遊會、嘉年華的氛圍，你可能已經從我穿的這件上衣注意到了。

lines.en: My sister designed this incredible logo for this round of Summerween, which I think is so cute.
lines.zh: 我妹妹為這一屆 Summerween 設計了一個很棒的標誌，我覺得超可愛。

lines.en: I really love this one because I really enjoy the like vintage look to it.
lines.zh: 我特別喜歡這個，因為我很喜歡它的復古感。

lines.en: And this time around, we have a lot of pinks and blues that just really complement each other really well, and we have our staple
lines.zh: 這次我們用了很多粉紅色和藍色，兩種顏色搭起來非常好看，還有我們的招牌

lines.en: ghosty front and center.
lines.zh: 小鬼魂站在正中間。

lines.en: Just adore everything about this logo, and I think my sister just knocks it out of the park every single time.
lines.zh: 我就是愛這個標誌的一切，我覺得我妹妹每一次都做得太棒了。

lines.en: So, for this readathon, we do have the five different reading prompts as always.
lines.zh: 這次的讀書活動，一如往常有五個不同的閱讀題目。

lines.en: You don't have to complete any of these reading prompts to participate in Summerween if you don't want to.
lines.zh: 如果你不想，完全不用完成任何一個題目也能參加 Summerween。

lines.en: The prompts are completely optional, but I do think they add so much fun to the readathon.
lines.zh: 這些題目完全是選擇性的，但我覺得它們讓活動更有趣。

lines.en: So, the first prompt is going to be the one that is our staple for this readathon, and that is to either read a book in the dark
lines.zh: 第一個題目是我們這個活動的招牌題目，就是在黑暗中讀一本書

lines.en: or reading a book at night.
lines.zh: 或在夜晚讀一本書。

lines.en: This one is such a staple to me because I think it's so much fun to like read a horror
lines.zh: 這一題對我來說是招牌，因為我覺得在黑暗中讀恐怖

lines.en: book in the dark.
lines.zh: 小說超級好玩。

lines.en: And however you want to do that is fine.
lines.zh: 你想怎麼做都可以。

lines.en: If you want to just like read your Kindle in the dark, if you want to listen to an audiobook
lines.zh: 你可以只是在黑暗中看你的 Kindle，也可以在黑暗中聽有聲書，

lines.en: in the dark, if you want to actually like take a flashlight and go under your blankets and read a physical
lines.zh: 也可以真的拿手電筒躲進被窩裡，讀一本紙本

lines.en: book, you can do that.
lines.zh: 書，都行。

lines.en: You can adjust this prompt to however it works best for you, but this is definitely one of my favorite
lines.zh: 你可以把這個題目調整成對你最適合的方式，但這絕對是我最愛放進這類

lines.en: things to include for these read-a-thons.
lines.zh: 活動的題目之一。

lines.en: The second prompt is going to be another easy one because it's going to be to read a thriller or a horror book.
lines.zh: 第二個題目也很簡單，就是讀一本驚悚或恐怖小說。

lines.en: I like to keep these pretty broad, you know, because I like to have a prompt where you can just check it off right away.
lines.zh: 我喜歡讓這些題目範圍寬一點，因為我想要有一個你馬上就能打勾的題目。

lines.en: And because the whole goal of this read-a-thon is to bring the spooky vibes of Halloween into the summer, I feel like reading horror
lines.zh: 而且因為這個活動的整個目標，是把萬聖節的驚悚氛圍帶進夏天，我覺得讀恐怖

lines.en: and thriller books is a good way to do that.
lines.zh: 和驚悚小說是個很好的方法。

lines.en: The third one is a new prompt and I really, really love this one because it's to read a new
lines.zh: 第三個是新題目，我真的非常喜歡，因為它是要讀一位對你來說

lines.en: to you author.
lines.zh: 很新的作者。

lines.en: So, this is just to read an author that you've never read from before.
lines.zh: 也就是讀一位你以前從沒讀過的作者。

lines.en: I think this is a great way to like experiment and like try somebody new.
lines.zh: 我覺得這是個很棒的方式，讓你嘗試、試試新的人。

lines.en: Maybe there's a debut author this year who just published their first ever thriller or horror book.
lines.zh: 也許今年有位新人作者剛出版了他的第一本驚悚或恐怖小說。

lines.en: Or maybe there's an author that you've been wanting to try for a long time and now this is your chance.
lines.zh: 或者也許有位作者你想試很久了，現在正是機會。

lines.en: The fourth prompt is going to be to read a book with pink on the cover because since we do have so much pink
lines.zh: 第四個題目是讀一本封面有粉紅色的書，因為我們的標誌裡

lines.en: in this logo, I thought it would be really cute to like tie that in to one of the prompts.
lines.zh: 有這麼多粉紅色，我覺得把它放進題目裡會很可愛。

lines.en: Now, I also feel like there's been a surge of pink book covers lately, especially in like the horror genre.
lines.zh: 而且我覺得最近粉紅色封面的書變多了，尤其是在恐怖類型裡。

lines.en: So, I feel like this one will actually be pretty easy to check off.
lines.zh: 所以我覺得這一題其實很容易打勾。

lines.en: It doesn't matter how much pink is on the cover as long as it's there.
lines.zh: 只要封面上有粉紅色就行，多少都沒關係。

lines.en: And then the fifth and final prompt is going to be to read a book that's less than 250 pages.
lines.zh: 第五個也是最後一個題目，是讀一本少於 250 頁的書。

lines.en: So, this could be a novella, this could be a manga, this can be a graphic novel.
lines.zh: 所以可以是中篇小說、漫畫，或圖像小說。

lines.en: I think having a prompt like this is so great for a read-a-thon because I know that I like to have ones that I can check off easily.
lines.zh: 我覺得讀書活動有這樣的題目很棒，因為我知道我喜歡有些題目可以輕鬆打勾。

lines.en: And reading something short is a really great way to do that.
lines.zh: 而讀短的東西正是很棒的方法。

lines.en: So, those are our five official prompts for the read-a-thon and I'm so excited about those.
lines.zh: 這就是我們的五個官方題目，我對它們超興奮。

lines.en: But like I was saying earlier, you don't have to complete all the prompts to participate.
lines.zh: 但就像我前面說的，你不需要完成所有題目才能參加。

lines.en: You can only do one of them if you want to.
lines.zh: 你可以只做其中一個，如果你想的話。

lines.en: Or I know a lot of people in the past have always tried to like find one book that completes
lines.zh: 或者我知道過去很多人會試著找一本書，同時完成

lines.en: all five prompts, so you can do that.
lines.zh: 全部五個題目，你也可以這樣做。

lines.en: Whatever floats your boat, floats mine.
lines.zh: 你覺得怎樣開心就怎樣，我也開心。

lines.en: I'm not going to be policing anybody's TBRs.
lines.zh: 我不會去管任何人的待讀書單。

lines.en: And if you're over on Instagram, we do have an Instagram for the read-a-thon that is called @thisissummerween.
lines.zh: 如果你在 Instagram 上，我們有這個活動的 Instagram，叫 @thisissummerween。

lines.en: And over there, we have a lot of other really fun challenge things going on.
lines.zh: 那裡還有很多其他很好玩的挑戰。

lines.en: We do have an Instagram prompts daily challenge.
lines.zh: 我們有 Instagram 每日題目挑戰。

lines.en: So, these are like different things that you can be posting daily to Instagram during the read-a-thon.
lines.zh: 就是活動期間你可以每天發到 Instagram 的不同東西。

lines.en: It's like a mix of of photos or different reels that you could be making that I think are going to be so much fun.
lines.zh: 有照片和各種短影片可以拍，我覺得會超好玩。

lines.en: And then on Instagram, we also do have a bingo board.
lines.zh: 然後在 Instagram 上，我們也有賓果板。

lines.en: The bingo board includes so many different things like some of the reading prompts, but then also like different activities
lines.zh: 賓果板上有很多不同的項目，像是一些閱讀題目，還有不同的活動，

lines.en: like listening to a spooky playlist or like watching a scary movie, different stuff like that.
lines.zh: 像是聽驚悚歌單，或看恐怖電影之類的。

lines.en: So, if you're interested in either the bingo board or the Instagram daily challenges, I will highly recommend to check out our Instagram.
lines.zh: 所以如果你對賓果板或 Instagram 每日挑戰有興趣，我強烈推薦去看看我們的 Instagram。

lines.en: I'll have that linked down below.
lines.zh: 連結會放在下面。

lines.en: But this one sounds like it's going to be like haunted house horror.
lines.zh: 這本聽起來是鬼屋恐怖類型。

lines.en: Oh my gosh, also the new Nat Cassidy short story collection is publishing in the month of May.
lines.zh: 天啊，還有 Nat Cassidy 的新短篇小說集五月要出版了。

lines.en: It's called I Know a Place or like I know places or something like that.
lines.zh: 書名叫《I Know a Place》，或是「我知道一些地方」之類的。

lines.en: I'm definitely going to be reading this one in the month of May, like guaranteed.
lines.zh: 我絕對會在五月讀這本，保證。

lines.en: Because Nat Cassidy is like one of my top favorite horror authors, and I've really, really been looking forward to the short story collection.
lines.zh: 因為 Nat Cassidy 是我最喜歡的恐怖小說作家之一，我一直非常期待這本短篇小說集。

lines.en: One of the romance books that I'm dying to get to is In Stormy Weather.
lines.zh: 我迫不及待想讀的愛情小說之一是《In Stormy Weather》。

lines.en: I'm really hoping that I can include this in some kind of video this month.
lines.zh: 我真的希望這個月能把它放進某支影片。

lines.en: Like maybe I'll try to read it for that 24-hour reading challenge, or maybe I'll try to include it somewhere.
lines.zh: 像是也許我會試著在那個 24 小時閱讀挑戰裡讀它，或者也許會想辦法放進別的地方。

lines.en: I might actually just need to do a video dedicated to like catching up on some of the arcs that I'm excited
lines.zh: 我可能真的需要做一支專門的影片，來補完一些我很期待的

lines.en: about because I have so many that I'm looking forward to.
lines.zh: 試讀本，因為我有太多想看的了。

lines.en: This is a romance that I'm so positive is going to be five stars for me, like why?
lines.zh: 這是一本我很確定會給五顆星的愛情小說，為什麼呢？

lines.en: I don't know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: But it's an academic rivals-to-lovers romance about storm-chasing meteorologists.
lines.zh: 但這是一本學術宿敵變戀人的愛情小說，主角是追風暴的氣象學家。

lines.en: And it says for fans of Ali Hazelwood and B.K.
lines.zh: 而且說是適合 Ali Hazelwood 和 B.K.

lines.en: Borison, which I am a fan.
lines.zh: Borison 的粉絲，而我就是粉絲。

lines.en: And then some other books that I'm really hoping to get to very soon is Annie Knows Everything, as well as I Leave It Up to You.
lines.zh: 然後我很希望很快讀到的其他書，有《Annie Knows Everything》，還有《I Leave It Up to You》。

lines.en: I don't know if I'm necessarily going to be vlogging, you know, my experiences with these books.
lines.zh: 我不確定我會不會把讀這些書的經驗拍成 Vlog。

lines.en: I put both of the audiobooks on hold at my library, and so these ones might just be like books that I'm like listening
lines.zh: 我在圖書館預約了兩本有聲書，所以這幾本也許只會是我在

lines.en: to in the background whenever I get some free time.
lines.zh: 有空閒時間時，在背景聽的書。

lines.en: But these books are both, you know, like contemporary fiction books that I've just been so interested in reading recently.
lines.zh: 但這兩本都是當代小說，我最近一直很有興趣讀。

lines.en: Those are all of my TBR plans, all of the Summerween announcement, everything that you need to know.
lines.zh: 這就是我所有的待讀書單計畫、所有 Summerween 公告，你需要知道的一切。

lines.en: Thank you so much for watching.
lines.zh: 非常感謝你們收看。

lines.en: I really do appreciate it.
lines.zh: 我真的很感激。

lines.en: You'll have to let me know, are you planning on participating in Summerween?
lines.zh: 請讓我知道，你打算參加 Summerween 嗎？

lines.en: Have you read any of these books that I just talked about, and if so, what are your thoughts on them?
lines.zh: 你有讀過我剛剛提到的任何書嗎？如果有，你覺得怎麼樣？

lines.en: Thank you so much for watching me here on YouTube.
lines.zh: 非常感謝你們在 YouTube 上看我。

lines.en: It literally means the world to me.
lines.zh: 這對我來說真的意義非凡。

lines.en: You have no idea.
lines.zh: 你們不知道這有多重要。

lines.en: I always feel so lucky and so grateful that so many of you are still tuning in to watch my videos
lines.zh: 我總是覺得好幸運、好感激，這麼多人這麼多年後

lines.en: all these years later.
lines.zh: 還在看我的影片。

lines.en: It really does mean the world to me.
lines.zh: 這真的對我意義非凡。

lines.en: So, thank you so much for being here, and I'll see you next time with another video.
lines.zh: 所以，非常謝謝你們來這裡，我們下次影片見。

lines.en: Bye.
lines.zh: 掰掰。
